language: Egyptian (Early and Classical Middle Egyptian), middle hieratic book hand; black ink with red rubrics. Transcription is Egyptological transliteration from the TLA corpus edition; translation is English (Leipzig papyrusebers.de, with documented exceptions).

regions.text: ḫnm〈.tw〉 =f swt m wrḥ mj.tt hrw. PL 10 ḥr wrḥ dwꜣ zp-2 r dr =sn sšr-mꜣꜥ ḥḥ n zp
regions.translation: But he is treated by rubbing the aforesaid for 10 days, rubbing in very early in the morning, until it is expelled. Really excellent, (proved) many times!

hl.t: 𓐍𓈖𓌰𓅓𓂉𓐎 𓆑 𓇓𓅱𓏏 𓅓 𓅨𓂋𓎛𓏌𓂝 𓏇𓏏𓏏𓏛 𓉔𓂋𓏲𓇳𓏥 𓎆 𓁷𓏤 𓅨𓂋𓎛𓏌𓂝 𓇼𓄿𓇳 𓊗𓏤𓏤 𓂋 𓂧𓂋𓀜 𓋴𓈖𓏥

regions.text: k.t n.t dr dꜣw.t m dp jr dꜣ dp n s ḫr =k wꜣḫ =k ḏr.t =k ḥr dp =f n šni̯ =f sj jri̯.ḫr =k n =f ḥsmn nḏ ḥr mrḥ.t bj.t mnḥ jri̯ m (j)ḫ.t wꜥ.t wt ḥr =s
regions.translation: “Another to expel pains (?) in the head: if a man’s head aches (?), then thou shalt lay thy hand on his head without his perceiving it; thou shalt prepare for him: natron, ground with oil, honey and wax, are mixed together and (it) is bandaged therewith.”

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓈖𓏏 𓂧𓂋𓀜 𓂧𓄿𓅱𓏏𓐎𓏥 𓅓 𓁶𓏤
𓇋𓂋 𓂧𓄿𓅯𓐎 𓁶𓏤 𓈖 𓊃𓀀𓏤 𓐍𓂋 𓎢 𓎝𓎛𓏛 𓎢 𓂧𓏏𓏤 𓎢 𓁷𓏤 𓁶𓏤 𓆑
𓁹𓐍𓂋 𓎢 𓈖 𓆑 𓍖𓈖𓈒𓏪 𓐩𓏌𓂝 𓁷𓏤 𓌻𓂋𓎛𓏏𓏌𓏥 𓆤𓏏𓏌𓏥 𓏠𓈖𓎛𓈒𓏥

regions.text: k.t pẖr.t n.t dp mḥr =f ssꜣꜣ wḫd.w sntr 1 ḏdꜣ n jbw 1 jbrj 1 js. PL 1 ꜥd 1 nḏ psi̯ wrḥ jm
regions.translation: Another remedy for a head which suffers from śs: frankincense 1, fat of the bw-plant 1, ladanum 1, śśś 1, grease 1, are ground, boiled and (it) is anointed therewith.

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓄲𓂋𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓈖𓏏 𓁶𓏤 𓍋𓅓𓂋𓅪 𓆑 𓋴𓋴𓅬𓄿𓄿 𓐎𓅪𓏪
𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓆓𓂧𓄿𓏯𓏛 𓈖 𓇋𓃀𓏲𓆰𓏥 𓏤 𓇋𓃀𓂋𓇋𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓇋𓋴𓋴𓋴𓆰𓏥 𓏤 𓎙𓂧𓏌𓏥 𓏤

regions.text: k.t n.t dp mḥr =f ssꜣi̯.t wḫd.w sntr 1 tpnn 1 pr.t wꜥn 1 mrḥ.t ⸮ꜣpd? 1 psi̯ wrḥ jm
regions.translation: Another for a head which is ill, something that removes purulency: frankincense 1, cumin 1, fruit of juniperus 1, goosefat 1, is boiled and (it) is anointed therewith.

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓈖𓏏 𓁶𓏤 𓍋𓅓𓂋𓅪 𓆑 𓋴𓋴𓅬𓏏𓂻 𓏲𓐍𓂧𓏲𓐎𓏥
𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓏏𓊪𓈖𓈖𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓍁𓏏𓏥 𓏲𓂝𓈖𓐎𓆮 𓏤 𓌻𓂋𓎛𓏏𓏌𓏥 𓅬 𓏤

regions.text: k.t n.t srwḫ dp tj-šps 1 jbsꜣ 1 gnn n ẖs(ꜣ).yt 1 sntr 1 wrḥ jm rꜥ-nb{.t} srwḫ dp pw
regions.translation: Another to treat the head: cinnamon 1 , bś 1, the liquid of ẖśjt 1, frankincense 1, (it) is anointed therewith every day. It is treatment of the head.

hl.t: 𓍘𓀻𓋴𓏌𓏥 𓏤 𓃙𓏤𓐟𓏤𓆰𓏥 𓏤 𓎼𓈖𓈖𓈒 𓈖 𓄡𓋴𓇋𓇋𓏏𓁸𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓏤

regions.text: k.t ḫnt.t m sntr 1 wrḥ dp jm ꜥšꜣ zp-2
regions.translation: Another: ḫntt in frankincense 1, the head is anointed therewith very often.

regions.text: k.t n.t ssnb dp mḥr =f js.w 1 wꜥn 1 ꜥd-ꜥš 1 pꜣꜥr.t 1 sntr 1 ꜥd 1 nḏ rḏi̯ r dp
regions.translation: Another to cure a head which is ill: św 1, juniperus 1, pinetar 1, bayberry (?) 1, frankincense 1, grease 1, are ground and applied to the head.

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓈖𓏏 𓋴𓋴𓈖𓃀𓏛 𓁶𓏤 𓍋𓅓𓂋𓅪 𓆑
𓇋𓇩𓋴𓏲𓆰𓏥 𓏤 𓏲𓂝𓈖𓐎𓆮 𓏤 𓎙𓂧𓏌𓏥𓂝𓈙𓐎𓆮 𓏤 𓊪𓅯𓄿𓂝𓂋𓏏𓆱𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓎙𓂧𓏌𓏥 𓏤

regions.text: k.t tpnn 1 gsfn 1 pr.t tntm 1 ꜥntj.w 1 bꜣq 1 pr.t wꜥn 1 sšn nḏ ḏi̯ r dp
regions.translation: Another: cumin 1, sagapen 1, fruit of tntm 1, myrrh 1, balanites-oil 1, fruit of juniperus 1, lotus, are ground and applied to the head.

hl.t: 𓏏𓊪𓈖𓈖𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓎼𓋴𓆑𓈖𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓍁𓏏𓏥 𓏏𓈖𓍃𓅓𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓂝𓈖𓅂𓏌𓏥 𓏤 𓆮𓏌𓏥 𓏤 𓍁𓏏𓏥 𓏲𓂝𓈖𓐎𓆮 𓏤 𓊃𓈙𓈖𓆸

regions.text: k.t n.t sqbb dp mḥr =f ztj 1 sntr 1 ḫt-ꜥwꜣ 1 wꜣnb 1 tj-šps 1 db n hnn 1 qmy.t 1 nṯr.yt 1 dbn n qd.w 1 ḏꜣr.t 1 mw 1 nḏ ḏi̯.w r dp
regions.translation: Another to cool a head which is ill: yellow ochre 1, frankincense 1, aloe 1, wnb 1, cinnamon 1, stag’s horn 1, gum 1, nṯrjt 1, dbn of the mason 1, ḏrt 1, water 1, are ground and applied to the head.

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓈖𓏏 𓋴𓈎𓃀𓃀𓏁𓈗 𓁶𓏤 𓍋𓅓𓂋𓅪 𓆑
𓐮𓏏𓏭𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓆱𓂝𓍯𓄿𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓍯𓄿𓈖𓃀𓆰𓏥 𓏤 𓍘𓀻𓋴𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓂧𓃀𓄏 𓈖 𓉔𓈖𓈖𓄛 𓏤 𓅯𓇋𓇋𓏏𓈒𓏪 𓏤 𓊹𓂋𓇋𓇋𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓄲𓈖𓏌𓏥 𓈖 𓀨𓏲𓂝𓀀 𓏤 𓍑𓄿𓂋𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓏤 𓈗 𓏤

regions.text: k.t n.t dp n.t smꜣ sntr rʾ-64 ḥḏ. PL rʾ-64 nṯr.yt rʾ-32 snn rʾ-32 wꜣḏ.w rʾ-16 ms~ḏw~mw.t~ rʾ-32 bjꜣ-Qsj rʾ-32 wꜣḥ-nḥb.t rʾ-64 mw gs 1/64 nḏ ḏi̯ r smꜣ (vacat: Rest der Zeile freigelassen)
regions.translation: Another for the head and the temple: frankincense 1/2 ro, styrax 1/2 ro, nṯrjt 1 ro, balm of Mecca 1 ro, malachite 2 ro, stibium 1 ro, magnetite 1 ro, wḥ-nḥbt 1/2 ro, water 2 1/2 ro, are ground and applied to the temple.

hl.t: 𓊹𓌢𓏏𓂋𓈒𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤 𓌉𓌉𓌉𓆰𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤 𓊹𓂋𓇋𓇋𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤 𓋴𓇑𓇑𓈖𓈒𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤 𓇅𓈋𓈒𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤 𓀔𓈋𓅐𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤 𓃀𓇋𓎺𓄑𓀫𓋴𓏭𓀀 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤 𓎝𓎛𓏛𓅘𓎛𓃀𓏏𓊌 𓂋𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓎆𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤 𓈗 𓐛 𓂆
𓂞 𓂋 𓄥𓄿𓁸 (vacat: Rest der Zeile freigelassen)

regions.text: ḥꜣ.t-ꜥ m pẖr.t n.t dr ṯs.t-n.t-mw.yt mḥr kns sw.t rʾ-8 bnj ḥsb wꜥḥ psi̯ ḥsb mw gs ḥsb nḏ ꜥtḫ zwr r hrw 4
regions.translation: The beginning of remedies to remove retention of the urine, when the hypogastric region is painful: wheat 4 ro, dates 8 ro, toasted manna 8 ro, water 24 ro, are ground, strained and taken for 4 days.

hl.t: 𓄂𓂝 𓅓 𓄲𓂋𓏏𓈒𓏥 𓈖𓏏 𓂧𓂋𓀜 𓋭𓏏𓍢𓈖𓏏𓈗𓇋𓇋𓏏𓂺 𓍋𓅓𓂋𓅪 𓎢𓈖𓋴𓄹
𓋴𓅱𓏏𓇢𓏥 𓂋𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤𓏤 𓇜𓏤𓌾𓏥 𓏴 𓇹𓈒𓏥 𓊮 𓏴 𓈗 𓐛 𓏴

regions.text: k.t n.t rḏi̯.t w(s)š ẖrd ṯs.w-n-mw.yt n.tj m ẖ.t =f šꜥ.t js.t snwḫ.tj ḥr mrḥ.t gs ẖ.t =f r mꜣꜥ wsš.t =f
regions.translation: Another to cause a child to evacuate an accumulation of urine which is in his belly: an old letter boiled with oil, his belly is rubbed, until his urination is in order.

hl.t: 𓎢𓏏 𓈖𓏏 𓂋𓂝𓏏 𓏲𓈙𓂺 𓀔𓀀 𓎀𓊃𓏲𓍞𓐎𓏥𓈖𓈗𓇋𓇋𓏏𓂺 𓈖𓏏𓏭 𓅓 𓄡𓏏𓏤 𓆑
𓐛𓊃𓏌𓂝 𓄡𓏏𓏤 𓆑 𓂋 𓌷𓂝𓏛 𓏲𓊃𓈙𓏏𓂺 𓆑
